result.interpretation: The only field write is the setter's putstatic. Every direct setter call is preceded by anewarray, except the class initializer call: it allocates the array at bci 7, then pushes/stores an int before invokestatic at bci 12, leaving the nonnull array below it.
result.limits: This archives Java class-file putstatic/invokestatic references and method handles. It does not exclude reflective or native writes elsewhere in the program.
